visualCharacteristics: Multi-step package configurator with selectable product, add-on, promo and hardware cards in the content column, a sticky order basket on the side and a fixed order bar at the bottom on small screens.
contentPattern: One row per item: cell 1 names the item kind (step, usp, benefit, product, addon, addon-band, legend, note, teaser, promo, card, service, basket, basket-item, basket-total, basket-cta; add "selected" for the preselected card), cell 2 (and 3) hold its headings, images, lists and links; consecutive same-kind rows form one group.
usage: Use on program and product pages where the visitor configures a TV/internet package and sees a running order basket.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any package configurator by authoring kind-labelled rows; do not split steps or basket into separate blocks.
